en.title: Marvel's Wolverine Actor Confirms Supporting Role in GTA 6
en.summary: A familiar voice from the Marvel universe is joining the streets of Vice City. Brett Gipson, known for his role as Sabretooth in the upcoming **Marvel's Wolverine** game, has officially added **Grand Theft Auto 6** to his acting credits.
en.body:
The rumble of **Grand Theft Auto 6** continues to grow, and now, a prominent actor from another highly anticipated title has stepped forward. **Brett Gipson**, who is lending his voice to the formidable Sabretooth in **Marvel's Wolverine**, has confirmed his involvement in Rockstar Games' next open-world opus. Gipson's resume now lists a role as a character named Ellis in **GTA 6**, adding another layer of intrigue to the game's expanding cast.

While details surrounding Ellis are scarce, and the character has not been featured in any released trailers or screenshots, Gipson's involvement suggests a supporting capacity. This isn't the first time actors have revealed their roles in **GTA 6** through unofficial channels, with others like Katie Burke, Ignacio Navarro, and Massi Furlan also disclosing their participation. It's possible that Rockstar Games is beginning to loosen its traditionally tight-lipped approach to casting as the game's launch approaches, or perhaps these actors are simply sharing their professional achievements.

## A Crossover of Iconic Characters

The connection between **Marvel's Wolverine** and **Grand Theft Auto 6** might seem unexpected, but it highlights the dynamic nature of the gaming industry. **Brett Gipson** is set to portray a major antagonist in **Marvel's Wolverine**, a game developed by Insomniac Games, known for its stellar work on the **Marvel's Spider-Man** series. His move to **GTA 6**, developed by Rockstar Games, signifies the caliber of talent being drawn to this monumental project. Fans have long speculated about the full roster of characters and voice actors that will populate **GTA 6**'s sprawling world, and this confirmation adds a significant name to the growing list of confirmed talent.

## The Road to Vice City

With **GTA 6** slated for release in 2026, the trickle of casting news is likely to continue. Performance capture for the game is reportedly nearing completion, and pre-orders are expected to open soon. The recent reveal of the official cover art has only intensified anticipation, solidifying the November release window. While Rockstar Games has historically kept its casting choices under wraps until much closer to launch, the current wave of actor confirmations suggests a potential shift in their marketing strategy. Whether Rockstar will officially announce Gipson's role or any other casting details remains to be seen, but fans are eager for any breadcrumbs leading them closer to the game's release.

## What's Next

As marketing for **Grand Theft Auto 6** ramps up, keep an eye out for further official announcements regarding its cast and potential new trailer drops. Pre-orders opening later this week could signal more significant reveals from Rockstar Games.

content_raw: A handful of actors have started confirming they have roles in Grand Theft Auto , including one of the stars of Marvel's Wolverine. Actor Brett Gipson, who plays Sabretooth in Marvel's Wolverine, has added GTA 6 to his resume . The resume notes that he will be playing a character named Ellis, but no other details have been confirmed. It's unclear how big his role will be but, for what it's worth, there's no indication that we've even seen Ellis in any of the trailers or screenshots thus far. Although the focus has been primarily on the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, Rockstar has shone a light on a few supporting characters, including Jason's friend, Cal Hampton, and his boss, Brian Heder. Gipson isn't the only actor to reveal their in GTA 6. Actors like Katie Burke, Ignacio Navarro, and Massi Furlan have all disclosed that they're in the highly anticipated game. Some of these appear to be s unclear if Rockstar has granted actors permission to share their roles, but it would make sense as marketing ramps up for the game. It's likely that performance capture for GTA 6 has concluded, or is close to being finished, as Rockstar barrels toward the finish line. Pre-orders will open for GTA 6 later this week, with some fans believing a third trailer may drop at the same time. Last week, Rockstar also revealed the official cover art for GTA 6 , which signaled to fans that the game is indeed releasing on time this November . Whether or not Rockstar itself will announce any casting for GTA 6 itself remains to be seen. Fans have spent years speculating over casting, and have even seemingly found out the actors for certain characters, but nothing has been confirmed. Previously, Rockstar has kept casting a secret up until the release of its games, but maybe it'll take a new approach with GTA 6.
